name: BD-20 761B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list WASP-140 and BD-20 761B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 5094154336332482304 and 5094154336332482176), 845 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 2.8e-8: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to WASP-140, 845 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 178284729 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 178284729 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: BD-20 761B is a star of 3,968 K, bound to WASP-140 845 AU away.
text.introduction: BD-20 761B shares its motion through space with WASP-140, 845 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: BD-20 761B's orbit around WASP-140 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
